tool_input.message: One correction to ed1d9b8. docs/design-opencode-plugin.md ~1628-1629, "The rows whose counterexample is a refusal model route (b)", is too broad. The spec (~3355-3361) says the rows ending in an operator claim then a refusal model route (b), and C17_off_noop (Copilot's trace, refused) is reachable only by route (a), because the dead call wrote its claim. Replace the sentence with: "The rows whose counterexample ends in an operator claim and then a refusal model route (b); the refused form of Copilot's trace is reachable by route (a); the claimed-case rows depend on neither." Change nothing else. make check, explicit-path commit of the design doc only, no push. Report the hash.
